verdict.rationale: Trello documents its own REST API, authenticated with an API key and a user token, plus batch and webhook endpoints, so it can be driven programmatically without the UI. Token length and scope are configurable, which suggests non-interactive scripted use is possible. Nothing in the pack describes CI usage, a CLI, or a dedicated headless or service-account mode, and the token flow relies on a delegated user authorization step. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD integration guidance, service-account or non-interactive auth for pipelines, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: navigate to the Trello Auth tab and select the option Generate a new API Key.
The length of access and scope of permissions are all configurable via query params
There are two ways to authorize a client and receive a User Token.
